files.classification: S14 mixed original ABI/composition with S13 command transport/configuration binding; one S12 independent provider migration
findings: Classifier header combines original RTL_RELATIVE_NAME/SECTION_IMAGE_INFORMATION declarations, symbol renames and full-path adapter. Path provider passes NULL modern relative output then zeros original relative structure; do not move C-layout dependency wholesale to B.

Client header binds CsrClientCallServer to authenticated project transport and finite process support carrier; original message/capture ABI remains C. S13 must retain capture validation and request lifecycle.

Config provider binds caller-owned immutable command templates in TLS, including package-specific image boundary; it is not a generic native API facade. Keep package policy with product/common and assess original provider boundary in S13.
AMD64 forced _X86_ after nt.h selects guest NE classification behavior rather than host architecture. S14 must retain real per-TU macro selection while considering original header ownership.

OpenNtBaseIsConsoleHandle uses only SDK GetConsoleMode and original low-bit pseudo-handle signature, preserving LastError. Move function byte-identically D to B; retain original symbol and input/output and shared archive object/link order. Both original C caller and common RPC caller keep same provider.
